translations.translatedText: # Sunday 9.10.2022 (radio)
Kertš Strait bridge. Reception centres. Tax rate. Autumn bird migration. Weather forecast.
## Kertš Strait bridge

![Partly collapsed bridge. A fire burning on the bridge in the background.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1500,h_843,x_0,y_400/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-101837563413e4e479f5/1665220605)
Open image viewer
Part of the Kertš Strait bridge collapsed in the explosion. Photo: Ukrainian security service
Russia has ordered divers to investigate the damage to the Kertš Strait bridge. The divers must find out how much the bridge was damaged.
An explosion broke the Kertš Strait bridge on Saturday morning. Part of the bridge collapsed. The damage to the Kertš Strait bridge is a big loss for Russia.

British military experts say that the explosion makes it harder for the Russian army to get supplies in Crimea and southern Ukraine. The bridge has been an important route for Russia to take heavy weapons to Crimea.
## Reception centres
![Finnish Immigration Service in Helsinki. 3.2.2021.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5568,h_3132,x_0,y_296/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-769765601aa93c154d6/1643195926)
Open image viewer
The Finnish Immigration Service has intervened in problems at reception centres. Photo: Jorge Gonzalez / Yle

Problems have been found at some reception centres in Finland for Ukrainians. For example, the reception allowance has not been paid to residents on time. Residents have not always been given food, or residents think the food has been bad.
The Finnish Immigration Service says the reason for the problems is that many reception centres are new. They have not yet learned to handle everything well.

The number of reception centres in Finland has more than quadrupled since Russia attacked Ukraine. The Finnish Immigration Service has intervened in the problems that have occurred in the new reception centres.
## Tax rate
![A person studies the website of the Tax Administration.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6000,h_3375,x_0,y_19/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-780060603e34094ea64/1705402603)
Open image viewer
The information on your tax card can be updated in the Tax Administration's online service. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Many Finns may have a tax rate on their tax card that is too low. The Tax Administration estimates that about one million (1,000,000) Finns have a tax rate that is too low.

The tax rate may be too low if income has risen since last year. For example, there have been increases in national pensions, labour market subsidies and subsistence benefits this year. The employment of many people has also improved this year after the coronavirus situation.
You can update your own tax rate online in the Tax Administration's My Tax service.
## Autumn bird migration

![Cranes at Söderfjärden in Vaasa. Cranes gather here every autumn before they fly south.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6817,h_3836,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-10132516332d9d7913a5/1664277875)
Open image viewer
Cranes at Söderfjärden in Vaasa. Cranes always gather here in autumn. Photo: Anna Wikman / Yle
Autumn bird migration has gone normally.
Birdlife Finland, the association of bird enthusiasts, says that cranes had a record migration two weeks ago. On that occasion more than 50,000 cranes flew over Uusimaa in one day.

Bird migration in autumn is still going on. Most of the Arctic white-fronted geese have already come to Finland or continued their journey over Finland. Greylag geese are still waiting on the west coast of Finland. Also, for example, redwings, fieldfares, brambling and chaffinches are still on their migration.
## Weather
![Monday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12654231)
Open image viewer
The sun shines in many places. The sun shines most in the southwest.

On Monday the weather is mostly dry, that is, it does not rain. The sunniest place is in the southwest of the country. In the north it may rain a little. The temperature is between 10 and 14 degrees, in the north between 5 and 10 degrees.
